value.policy: VM entry/normal-return checks; synchronous computation; ordinary JSON output obeys the existing per-value UTF-8 allocation ceiling (trap 14)

clock_entropy_secret.policy: VM boundary checks around synchronous host access

sleep.policy: shared remaining budget, requested waits <=50 ms

log.policy: synchronous stderr write/flush; partial output possible

file.policy: Context checkpoints around synchronous file operations and bounded read chunks; partial writes possible. Read scratch and final output copy reserve the shared native-byte budget; budget exhaustion traps 14. File descriptor accounting remains incomplete; host calls are not preemptible within a syscall.

limiter.policy: timed state-lock admission; admitted token consumption completes

observation.policy: timed observation-lock admission; terminal telemetry may be omitted

storage.policy: timed locks and prepublication checkpoints; entered replacement cleanup completes; opt-in authority lock consumes Store/VM admission budget; snapshot hashing is synchronous; authority advancement, receipts and exact staged recovery retain commit ambiguity and complete admitted durability work before return Version-2 authority checks the active writer identity after store/authority lock acquisition, including no-op mutations; trusted fence-key advances ciphertext and writer policy through the same admitted publication boundary. Initial host migration uses the same deadline for store and recovery-copy locks, synchronous SQLite integrity/encryption checks, recovery-copy durability before active publication, and the existing admitted active publication barrier.

outbound.policy: 8192-byte URL and 1 MiB body/model JSON payload limits before transport; shared budget includes preparation and bounded model serialization; inherited VM context; DNS remains synchronous

local_provider.policy: synchronous trusted companion, no context transfer; restricted VMs reject

evolution.policy: Minimum wave/VM budget for preparation and apply admission; child reaping and admitted journal completion precede owned staging cleanup. Cleanup may exceed the budget; primary exceptions survive cleanup failure, and abrupt parent death may leave staging.

serving.policy: serving/request budgets capped by 10-second connection lifetime and 100-request quota; bounded response serialization; FIFO connection queue with explicit fairness limits; drain/abort then join; service-token requests reload the pinned private file with context checks before/after synchronous reading; invalid/unavailable credentials fail closed before handler admission; already admitted requests retain context

resource.policy: Context checks before/after native operations; buffer data-lock waits poll at 50 ms; mapping population checks between writes of at most 65536 bytes and between initialization stages. Allocation, copies, sealing, mmap and physical cleanup are synchronous and not preemptible within a host operation. Logical close rejects new leases; admitted leases defer physical release. Failed cleanup retains ownership and charges for retry; ambiguous raw descriptor close is quarantined, never retried by descriptor number. Idle VM teardown reports unresolved cleanup. Explicit capacity limits are not wall-time or RSS guarantees. VM cancellation and GC checks remain per instruction. The single heap mutator lock may span at most 32 instructions, released around native/nested work and at every frame exit. Deferred resource cleanup runs after physical lock release at batch boundaries or frame exit; no wall-time fairness bound is claimed.
